intro: The Indus Recliner gives power to pause. With genuine leather at touch points and smooth manual control, it’s where support meets ease in one graceful recline.

features.title: Upholstery that understands luxury
features.text: Our recliner is wrapped in half leather—genuine leather at all touch points for a soft, cool feel, and synthetic leather elsewhere for durability. It’s the perfect blend of elegance and everyday ease.

features.title: Recline the way you deserve to
features.text: Our smooth manual mechanism lets you lean back effortlessly with just a gentle pull. It’s built with riveted steel linkages, tested for strength and designed to move silently, every time.

features.title: Support from top to tail
features.text: With a high backrest, headrest, and targeted lumbar support, our recliner encourages your spine to settle into comfort. Whether you’re upright or fully reclined, you’ll feel completely looked after.

features.title: Armrests that cushion you with care
features.text: Generously filled with soft Recron fibre, our armrests feel like pillows for your elbows. They cushion your arms without collapsing—offering comfort you can lean into, day after day.

features.title: A seat that feels like floating
features.text: We’ve used slab-stock foam in the seat, engineered for a subtle sinking-in feel. It supports your body while creating that perfect balance of softness and spring. You won’t want to get up.

features.title: Comfort that extends with you
features.text: Our sofa’s integrated footrest moves with your body—rising smoothly to lift your legs as you recline. It unfolds effortlessly using a manual handle, letting you shift into full-body comfort without needing to adjust or think twice. Just lean back, and let it support you.

name: Indus 2-Seater Leather Manual Recliner Sofa
